errors.text: The proposed CE–AIMD workflow does not reconstruct the target MTP-enabled free-energy perturbation method or its replacement of EAM-based thermodynamic integration.

Ordinary NVT AIMD does not directly provide absolute solid and liquid free energies; no valid thermodynamic integration, free-energy perturbation, coexistence, or reversible-scaling procedure is specified.
A 10^7-step AIMD calculation on 200-plus-atom cells is computationally prohibitive and incompatible with the stated goal of screening vast composition spaces.
The claimed link between dislocation friction or lattice distortion and the melting free-energy barrier is unsupported and confuses mechanical strengthening with equilibrium melting thermodynamics.
Heat capacity inferred from fluctuations in an NVT simulation is generally C_v, not C_p, absent an appropriate conversion or constant-pressure treatment.
The proposed applicability boundary of at least five components excludes the four-component TaVCrW target system.
The cited evidence concerns strength, deformation, processing, and phase constitution rather than validation of melting temperatures, fusion entropy, or free-energy accuracy.
The assertion that CALPHAD generally assumes ideal mixing is inaccurate; CALPHAD commonly includes assessed non-ideal excess Gibbs-energy terms.
